g.title: cluster_layer_2
g.text: Layer 2: GNN block construction and message-passing semantics

g.title: cluster_layer_3
g.text: Layer 3: Graph representation and structural tensor operations

g.title: graphnet_keras_layers
g.text: Role: Keras layers for GraphNet/MPNN architectures
Fit: compose encoder, processor, decoder GraphNet blocks

g.title: graphnet_block
g.text: Fit: edge update -> aggregate messages -> node update -> optional global update

g.title: graphnet_factories
g.text: Role: create Keras edge/node/global update MLPs and aggregators
Fit: declarative construction of GraphNet blocks

g.title: gcn_keras_layers
g.text: Role: Keras layers for sparse GCN architectures
Fit: direct sparse convolution over the shared graph tensor dict

g.title: tensor_dict_schema
g.text: Keys: nodes, edges, senders, receivers, n_nodes, n_edges,
Fit: consumed by both GraphNet/MPNN and GCN paths

g.title: update_functions
g.text: Role: learnable transformations for edge, node, and global states
Fit: Keras Models called by GraphNet edge/node/global blocks

g.title: aggregation_functions
g.text: Role: reduce messages with mean/sum/max/min or compound reducers
Fit: segment reductions used for edge->node and node/edge->global flow

g.title: object_graph
g.text: Role: object graph for construction, copying, subgraphs, connectivity

g.title: graph_tuple
g.text: Fit: bridges object graphs and tensor-dict computation

g.title: gt_ops
g.text: Role: preserve topology while transforming feature tensors
Fit: reusable functional helpers over tensor dicts

g.title: keras_ops
g.text: Role: concrete tensor execution and compilation target
Fit: backend_ops delegates primitive operations here
